candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Reference Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated companion control guide screen after home intro to explicitly demonstrate how to move, chat with, and hide desktop pets before completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to interact with, control, or hide the pet after onboarding, contributing to the 64.8% completion rate at the final step.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop

new_controls_card.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_controls_card.body: Drag your pet anywhere on screen, double-click to chat, or right-click to access quick tray settings.

components.text: Right-click pet for menu controls & hide option

guard.reason: screen 'new_controls_card' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Signature and Persona Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuilds the adoption certificate layout into a full-bleed official adoption record featuring a verified companion badge and formal pet naming prompt.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.9% with a 1017s mean time; strengthening the emotional commitment and visual polish helps lock in user engagement.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Desktop Companion Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new desktop companion a name to finalize your official adoption record.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate while preserving the official adoption seal job requirement.

candidates.score_note: Targets the step with the highest drop (30.1%), but relies solely on funnel data without support mail evidence and requires full screen rebuild.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Order Shift
candidates.change: Moves sign-in directly after adoption certificate completion so users secure their account right after bonding with and naming their pet.
candidates.why: 8 support emails report missing or reset pets after signing in. Placing sign-in right after pet creation ensures immediate account backup and prevents loss.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Adoption Record
sign_in.body: Sign in to save your newly created pet to your account and prevent progress loss.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Backed by strong support evidence (8 tickets) and funnel drop, but requires flow structural change.

candidates.title: Interactive Behavior Preview Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a dynamic behavior preview screen prior to path selection so users can watch desktop pets act out different daily routines before committing.
candidates.why: Mean duration on choose_path is high (514s), indicating user indecision during early path selection.

new_path_preview.headline: Preview Desktop Pet Life
new_path_preview.body: Watch how companions roam your screen, react to open apps, and rest alongside your work.

guard.reason: Inserting a behavior preview screen within onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Step has high conversion (91.3%); addressing high duration via a new sub-flow has high build cost for low potential lift.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly confirm that logging in restores previously adopted pets.
candidates.why: The largest cluster of support emails (8 tickets) comes from users confused about pets missing or reset after signing in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Existing Pets
sign_in.body: Already adopted a pet? Sign into your account to immediately restore your desktop companion and save current progress.
sign_in.hint: Your account keeps your companions safely synced across sessions.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy without changing pricing or mechanics is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses 8 support emails about post-sign-in confusion with a simple, high-confidence copy update.

candidates.title: Live Asset Generation Stage Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Configures the waiting screen into a structured stage layout with step progress indicators and estimated render times while pet assets construct.
candidates.why: Mean waiting step time is 2336s and 3 support tickets mention app stalling or pets failing to display on desktop.

waiting.headline: Building Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Rendering custom animations and configuring desktop interactions...

guard.reason: Adding stage indicators and real wait time estimates on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from funnel wait times (2336s) and 3 support tickets; visual progress indicators effectively lower drop-off.

candidates.title: Two-Column Pick Friend Persona Layout
candidates.change: Replaces the pick_friend layout with a two-column display separating visual pet artwork from personality trait details.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop in the funnel (69.9% conversion); clear visual organization reduces decision fatigue.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion Persona
pick_friend.body: Select a pet visual style on the left and review personality traits on the right.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend into a two-column layout preserves its core job.

candidates.score_note: Focuses on the largest funnel leak at adoption (69.9% conversion) with moderate layout adjustment effort.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Upload Spec Validation Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit lighting and photo format hints to the upload_photos screen to guide custom pet image creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report custom pet generation failures or incorrect visual outputs due to bad input photos.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload a clear front-facing photo with good lighting and contrast.

candidates.title: Background Generation Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enables a background desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app during long pet asset builds.
candidates.why: Mean waiting step time is 2336s (~38 mins), causing drop-off if users feel stuck staring at a loading screen.

waiting.hint: You can safely minimize this window. We will send a desktop alert as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adding a background desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost toggle directly mitigating the severe 38-minute wait duration highlighted by 3 support tickets.

candidates.title: Starter Desktop Accessory Choice Incentive
candidates.change: Displays a free starter item badge on choose_path screens rewarding users for starting their companion journey.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 27.2%; adding early reward motivation boosts momentum across the entire funnel.

choose_path.headline: Pick a Path & Claim Free Desktop Toy
choose_path.body: Choose your pet path today to unlock an exclusive starter toy accessory for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras ('Free Desktop Toy' / 'Free Starter Accessory Included'), which violates Rule 3.
